map.GIF 为何是多帧动画，如何用 ToolBox 提取单帧或全部帧用于表情包与动图: Why a GIF is a multi-frame animation, and how to use ToolBox to extract a single frame or all frames for emoji and animated image analysis.
map.GIF 是「帧的合集」: A GIF is 'a collection of frames'
map.GIF 动图本质是多张静态帧按延迟时间循环播放，因此可以把每一帧单独提取出来使用: A GIF animation is essentially several static frames played in a loop at set delays, so each frame can be extracted and used on its own.
map.截取表情包某一帧、分析动画时序、把动图关键帧做成静态素材等。: Capturing a single frame of an emoji set, analysing animation timing, turning key frames of an animation into static assets and so on.
map.上传 GIF 后预览各帧，可下载单帧或全部帧；注意帧数很多时全部导出文件量较大。: After uploading a GIF you can preview each frame and download a single frame or all of them; note that with many frames a full export produces a large number of files.
map.提取的帧会失真吗？: Will the extracted frames be distorted?
map.GIF 本身色域有限（最多 256 色），提取的帧与动图中对应帧一致。: A GIF itself has a limited colour range (256 colours at most), so the extracted frame matches the corresponding frame in the animation.
map.能改帧延时吗？: Can the frame delay be changed?
map.拆分主要做提取；调整延时/重组建议用专门 GIF 编辑工具或脚本。: Splitting is mainly extraction; for changing delays or reassembly use a dedicated GIF editor or script.
map.帧数多的 GIF 解析较慢且产出多，建议先确认只需的帧范围。: GIFs with many frames parse slowly and produce a lot of output, so confirm the range of frames you need first.
